description.name: Entry
description.text:
7 single attacks (3.05 each) capped at 19999, grants [Attach Dark with Stacking]/[Attach Holy with Stacking] depending on entry damage, grants [Damage Cap +10000], [Crystal Force Mode], and Crystal Force Mode: Cid Raines (Dark/Holy) to the user
Crystal Force Mode: Cid Raines (Dark/Holy): Dark/Holy Ability Boost, Dualcast Dark/Holy, Zero Hone Cost to Dark/Holy Abilities & 25% DEF/RES Pierce

description.name: Attach Dark with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Dark Level by 1 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Dark 3

description.name: Attach Holy with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Holy Level by 1 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Holy 3

description.name: Crystal Force Mode
description.text: Grants Crystal Force Mode, Replaces Attack and Defend commands with Crystal Force I & II, unlocks II after three actions
